t: This was the home of the Type Museum, also called the Type Archive, in Stockwell, South London. It was a collection of artefacts showing the legacy of type founding in England, whose foundries supplied the world with type in over 300 languages. It was founded in 1992 by Susan Shaw, a British publisher whose house made limited-edition books that can sell for thousands of pounds. In 2022 the Archive announced it would give up its building and return parts of its collections to other institutions.
